scope: One disposable, unchanged-product Firefox full recovery diagnostic. No B16 acceptance, original-video replacement, product repair, browser launch or external effect by reviewer.

findings.description: The original diagnostic evaluated before-state/stack before forwarding and after-state before returning. An observation exception could suppress the original clear or replace its return/throw, violating the claimed transparent forwarding.
findings.repair: The current driver isolates observation exceptions, forwards exactly once through Reflect.apply(original,this,args), returns inside try and logs inside finally. A distinct diagnosticObserverFidelity gate fails any logged observation error. Original v1 bytes are retained.

forwardingControls.cases: Cross of original normal return / thrown object and no observation failure / before-read failure / after-read failure.

observationAnalysis.finding: Public state copies stored stat fields and CSS visibility; public clear only hides detail and clears its local last composition. No surface()/presentation() access in state.
SalahMoonHost.capture reads the accepted scene, native clock and Moon scalars. The declared native FOLLOW_WALL_CLOCK case makes simNow a Date.now read. It does not publish or request terrain.
Preview state clones status; frame returns the existing preview frame. frame.current checks nativeResultCurrent against host.capture(false).

capture(false) avoids MoonRuntime.surface and layout. It calls simulationReady; the valid native-clock branch clears the empty hidden-state map. This is conditionally non-publishing in this case, not a universally side-effect-free getter.
Real-sky state clones status and reads plain lifecycle counters; it does not invoke lifecycle.current/observe.

The bounded original PNG acquisition starts after fixture elapsed 147 seconds and continues until final before-clock is at least six seconds beyond first after-clock. Every capture is full 390x600 viewport, animations allowed. This is the six-second causal diagnostic, not the required 30-second B16 motion alternative.

limitations: The wrapper sees calls to the public SalahMoonDetail.clear property. Lexically captured clear() calls inside MoonDetail.compose or other MoonDetail internals bypass it; absence of public clear events cannot rule those paths out.

The observer adds execution overhead, stack creation, state copies and read calls. A resulting diagnostic is a separate acquisition; it cannot retroactively associate original video frames with a source callback.

The candidate predicate detects a visible atmospheric-preview-owned detail becoming hidden while a preview frame is current. The actual caller stack and pixels still must be independently reviewed; a false predicate alone is not a complete diagnosis.

No full QA, MoonRuntime.state/surface/request, render, acquisition or model-install helper is used within the diagnostic capture interval. Existing checkpoint QA remains and may publish pending terrain before that interval.
Passing the forwarding controls does not prove behavior under arbitrary corrupted built-ins, out-of-memory or hostile error-to-string methods; those are outside this source-bound diagnostic.
All original Firefox recording failures, warm recovery Moon withdrawal and cold-start limitations remain retained.
